fontFamily is NOT bridged. Its consumers only concatenate it with a fallback

getTheme().fontFamily to write --gv-font-family; bridging would make the
variable refer to itself. fontFamily stays the raw tenant font.

commits.body:
tokens.source.json (W3C DTCG) holds every one of Tali's 187 --gv-* variables

$extensions.gv.redesign is Tali's value (and her .gv-bo remaps for the tenant

[data-gv-mode="redesign"] block re-declaring what changes and every reader),
tokens.ts (t, cssVar, TokenName, MODES) and tokens.meta.json for the scanner
and panels. --check exits 1 on drift, bad names or a broken source; normal
mode keeps the committed outputs when the source is unreadable.
